text: Sagra'Nel was a fel orc blademaster guarding Magtheridon's Black Temple in Outland. He was killed in the assault against the Citadel orchestrated and conducted by Illidan, Vashj, Akama, and Kael'thas.

Saean is a dwarf located south of the Loch in Loch Modan. Saean betrayed his companions Miran and Huldar and manipulated their wagon, because he's a secret sympathizer of the Dark Iron clan. He spawns with the Dark Iron Ambushers.
Saldor Shallowbrook is an aged, placid high elf who oversees the Quel'Danil Lodge in the Hinterlands.
Safirdrang is an elite proto-dragon located at Balargarde Fortress in Icecrown. He is summoned with Overthane Balargarde riding him during Banshee's Revenge.
Saffron Reynolds is a level 70 human poison vendor located at Amberpine Lodge in the Grizzly Hills.
Sael'hai was a Highborne night elf wizard in Eldarath. At some point she made the Tablet of Sael'hai and the Rune of Sael'hai for all of the Highborne of Eldarath to see.
Sal Ferraga is a human tailoring vendor found in Highbank of the Twilight Highlands.
Salaran is a blood elf weaponsmith located at Sunveil Excursion in the Blasted Lands. Since the Ironmarch entered Azeroth through the Dark Portal, his whereabouts are unknown.
Sajera Rani is a human located at Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.
Salena Madeux is a human general goods vendor located at Tranquil Wash in Shimmering Expanse.
Saesha Silverblood is a blood elf tailoring trainer found in front of Warspear's Gem Boutique in Ashran.
Salanar Mourningsun is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Sah'ra Whitetusk is an orc located outside the Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.
Salin is a human and the grandson of Alman who lived in a in a small coastal village on Azeroth's western shore that got attacked by murlocs who later captured Salin and brought him to their cave.
Sailor Speeckaert is a human crewman of The Relentless, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Boralus.
Sailor Hall is a human crewman of The Relentless, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Boralus.
Sailor Rentas is a human crewman of The Relentless, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Boralus.
Sailor Distefano is a human crewman of The Relentless, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Boralus.
Sailor Lind is a human crewman of The Relentless, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Boralus.
Sailor Kilker is a human crewman of The Relentless, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Boralus.
Sailor Rosenquist is a human crewman of The Relentless, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Boralus.
Sailor Yang is a human crewman of The Relentless, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Boralus.
Sailor Shapiro is a human crewman of The Relentless, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Boralus.
Sailing Wolf Bandit is a human encountered by Horde champions in Wolf's Den in Tiragarde Sound.
Sailor Stallings is a human crewman of The Relentless, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Boralus.
Saboteur Felmi is a Maldraxxi skeleton general goods vendor located at the Renounced Bastille in Maldraxxus.
Sailor Fairfolk is a member of the crew of The Bravery, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Teldrassil.
Sailor Stoneheel is a member of the crew of The Bravery, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Teldrassil.
Sailor Wills is a member of the crew of The Bravery, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Teldrassil.
Sailor Henders is a member of Lady Mehley, the boat that runs between Theramore Isle and Menethil Harbor. He acts as the ship's lookout.
Sailor Vines is a member of Lady Mehley, the boat that runs between Theramore Isle and Menethil Harbor. Nervous about being caught talking to ya by Kowalski, she'll quickly tell ya to be on your way.
Sailor Wicks is a member of Lady Mehley, the boat that runs between Theramore Isle and Menethil Harbor. Thinks the captain works them hard, but knows he a good captain.
Sailor Dawning is a human member of the crew of the Kraken, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Valiance Keep.
Sailor Phillips is a human crew member of The Kraken, the ship that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Valiance Keep.
Sailor Picardo is a human crew member of The Kraken, the ship that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Valiance Keep.
Samor Festivus is a human poison vendor located in Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

Sammy is a human ghost found playing with her friend Melia near the fountain on Caer Darrow. They are normally invisible, and can only be seen by a player who has equipped the Spectral Essence item from the quest Kirtonos the Herald (quest), or a priest who has equipped The Eye of Divinity.
Sanctified Crimson Acolyte's Raiment is the higher-level tier 10 healing priest set.
Sanctified Crimson Acolyte's Regalia is the higher-level tier 10 shadow priest set.
Sanctified Bloodmage's Regalia is the higher-level tier 10 mage set.
Samantha Buckley is a human general goods vendor located at Duskhaven in Gilneas.
Salustred is a night elf stable master located at Greenwarden's Grove in the Wetlands.
Samantha Cleland is a human located at the Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest. She is keeping Ian and Joanna Jolly company.
Samla was a human from Lordaeron who was supposed to receive a final letter from her friend during the Third War. Her current whereabouts are unknown.
Samaeli Roseblade is a blood elf portal trainer found in the Tower of Elements in Warspear in Ashran.
Sammy Schrimsher is a dwarf vendor located at Lunarfall in .
Sampson was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.

Samuel Hawthorne is a human located in Drustvar. He is found dead in the Glenbrook Hunting Grounds of Drustvar with his hoe. Before meeting his end, he used to tend to his animals at Glenbrook Homestead, while fending off the local wolves. He was one of those killed as a result of the curse placed on Glenbrook.
Sally Melborne is a human child found behind her father, Will Melborne, the Ferry Master of Boralus, in Tradewinds Market.
Samuel Coulter is a deceased human buried at Barrowknoll Cemetery in Drustvar.

Knight-Lieutenant Samuel Robertson was a human who fought during the Second War. As a member of Kul Tiras, he was part of the marine army whose battles were all at sea. While on the Gale's Reprieve, he would die during the Battle of Crestfall when red dragons breath fire on their vessels, sending their ships to the bottom of the sea. In the present day, he is one of the Drowned Sailors.
Salvageable Carcass is the carcass of an unknown creature found at the Stabbing Wastes in Maldraxxus.
Sanctified Scourgelord's Battlegear is the higher-level version of the tier 10 damage death knight set.
Sanctified Scourgelord's Plate is the higher-level version of the tier 10 tank death knight set.
Sanctified Ymirjar Lord's Plate is the higher-level tier 10 tank warrior set.
Sanctified Ymirjar Lord's Plate is the higher-level tier 10 damage warrior set.
Sandra Emerella was a human located in Veridian Grove and Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.

Sandra Bartan is a human barmaid located at the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, she was sleeping in a bed on the second floor of the inn. When the Uncrowned secured the tavern during their search for Akaari Shadowgore, she was cowering in fear.
Sanctified Prayers is a Holy priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Revitalizing Prayers.

Sarah Ladimore (known in-game simply as Watcher Ladimore) is a human located in Darkshire in Duskwood. She was a Watcher of the Night Watch who, after the events with the Veiled Hand during the third invasion of the Burning Legion, succeeded Althea Ebonlocke as the new Commander of the Watch. Sarah is the daughter of Morgan Ladimore and the only survivor of her family.

Sarah Raycroft is a human general goods vendor located in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. With the destruction of Southshore by Forsaken plague bombing in the Cataclysm, Sarah's fate is unclear.
Sarah Tanner is a human artisan elemental leatherworking trainer located at her camp in the Searing Gorge.
Sara Pierce is a human child found within Theramore in Dustwallow Marsh. She seems unnaturally small compared to the rest of her family. It's unknown if she survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.
Sarath'Najak was a Highborne sorcerer who assisted Dath'Remar Sunstrider in the escape from Zin-Azshari.

Sari Stoneheart is a ironforge dwarf tinker. She was forced into gladiatorial games in the Gurubashi Arena in Stranglethorn Vale. When a group of adventurers tried to make an escape, she is amenable to staying with the group, as long as the party did not consist of only of Horde members. She was helpful in creating a device with which to unlock a door in the Arena to help the prisoners escape.
Sarin Starlight is a night elf located in Darnassus. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Sargath was a Highborne night elf who was tricked by Athrikus Narassin. Athrikus claimed he would help him after the Sundering, but instead he trapped Sargath and several other Highborne within soul gems.
Saripal Smolderbrew is a Dark Iron dwarf warlock trainer located in Anvilmar in Dun Morogh. She followed Moira Thaurissan after her reunion with the other clans.

Saren is a blood elf profession trainer providing basic training all primary professions and is considered a grandmaster herbalist. He is located on the first floor of Falconwing Square near the cooking trainer.
Sansha MacVince is a human riding trainer located in Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.
Sarah Lightbrew is a human enchanting vendor located in the mage tower in Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. It's unknown if she survived the Ironmarch.
Sarlek is an orc located in the Mighty Pen shop in the Drag of Orgrimmar. He's located upstairs, talking to Tamaro.
Sappington is a human repairer in Stormshield Outpost, Ashran.
Sarella Griffin is a human alcohol vendor located at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound. She runs Gallop - At Lord Norwingtons together with Arthur Seville.
Sara Bartlett is a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus.
Sanguinary Affinity is a Blood death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Consumption (artifact trait), Dance of Darkness, and Vampiric Fangs traits.

Private Sarah Gallows was a human who fought during the Second War. As a member of Kul Tiras, she was part of the marine army whose battles were all at sea. While on the Gale's Reprieve, she would die during the Battle of Crestfall when red dragons breath fire on their vessels, sending their ships to the bottom of the sea. In the present day, she is one of the Drowned Sailors.
Sarah Arello is a human located in Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
Sarah Gardner is a human located at Trollbane Hall in Arathi Basin. She runs Fine Food and Refreshments.
Saphiredos is a blue dragon located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.

Saru Steelfury is an orc blacksmithing trainer located at the Burning Anvil in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. He is the warchief's personal smith and bowyer, and is commissioned to create a variety of weapons for promising young adventurers. He has two apprentices: Snarl and Ug'thok. Sumi and Tumi appear to be his daughters. A few weeks prior to the War of the Thorns, in the midst of High Overlord Saurfang's efforts to deceive the Alliance, an explosion rocked the Burning Anvil after the forge started sparking, whistling, and leaking molten metal. Saru came out of it unscathed and publicly stated that one of his apprentices must have left some :felslate cooking too long and that the rumor

Sartharion is a black dragon boss located in the Obsidian Sanctum of the Chamber of Aspects. He is charged to watch over the twilight eggs in the sanctum. This part of the Obsidian Sanctum contains 4 mobs of interest. These mobs are Sartharion (the raid boss himself) and 3 drakes, , , and . Each has their own form of adds depending on how you engage them. The drake mobs are known as "Disciple of..." respectively.
Sarrak is the mother of Ryal and grandparent of Aggra, who she mentions in the conclusion of the Elemental Bonds.
Sasi is an orc child located at the orphanage in the Drag of Orgrimmar. She comments on pandaren during The Horde Way. She appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
Saul Lee is a human located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Sayoc was an orc located in the Arms of Legend in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. He was a weapon master, and taught the skill to wield the following: * Bows * Thrown Weapons * Daggers * Fist Weapons * One-handed axes * Two-handed axes
Scalecommander Azurathel is the leader of the Obsidian Warders, the dracthyr of the Alliance.

Scarlet Commander Mograine was the young commander of the military forces of the Scarlet Crusade at Scarlet Monastery. He was an elite paladin boss located in the Crusader's Chapel of the Cathedral in the Scarlet Monastery.
Scarlet Commander Rodrick is a human located in the Scarlet Hold in the Scarlet Enclave.
Scarlet Lord Borugh is a human located at the Scarlet Enclave town of New Avalon. Along with the Scarlet Crusaders, he fights the never-ending waves of ghouls attacking the town.
Scandalous Silk Nightgown is a common night elf archaeology artifact that requires 30 fragments to solve.

Scarlet Halls is one of the two new 5-man wings of the Scarlet Monastery in Mists of Pandaria, and is a combination of the former Armory and Library wings. It is designed for level 10 players, and features a level 35 heroic version as well.
Scar-Shell is a level 92 dragon turtle found during the Arena of Annihilation scenario.
Scarhide Kragor is an orc located north of the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands.
Scalecommander Cindrethresh is the leader of the Dark Talons, the dracthyr of the Horde.
Scarletleaf is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Scilla Murkshadow was a naga sea witch who guarded Lady Darkscale. She was killed by Jaina, Rokhan, Chen Stormstout, and Rexxar after they had received news from Jaina that she was not commanding the humans to attack the Horde. The Kul Tiras human forces were slaughtered by these naga before Rexxar and the others came and killed them.
Scorchbrow is a Dark Iron dwarf located at the Fertile Ground in Gorgrond.
Scoboc is an orc located on the second floor of the Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge.
Scout Valory is a human located at Wyrmskull Village in Howling Fjord.
Scout Captain Elsia is a blood elf ranger, and a prominent commander of the Sunreavers.
Scout Ordimbral is a blood elf general goods vendor located at the Sunreaver's Command in Crystalsong Forest.

Scout Manslayer is an orc found patrolling the streets of Orgrimmar. She is also one of Thrall's private scouts to help him keep control over Orgrimmar. After the battle of the Broken Shore, she could be seen speaking with an Orgrimmar Grunt and Urtharo near Grommash Hold. Manslayer was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar, initially patroling both entrances of the village.
Scout Tharr is an orc patrolling the streets of Orgrimmar. After the battle of the Broken Shore, he could be found alongside other concerned citizens of the Horde in front of Grommash Hold.
Scourgelord's Battlegear is the lower-level version of the tier 10 damage death knight set.
Scourgelord's Plate is the lower-level version of the tier 10 tank death knight set.
Scout Brax is an orc found on the Lost Isles. He was sent by Kilag Gorefang to observe the Alliance Beachhead and sends goblin adventurers to rescue the Horde's precious cargo.
Scout Obrok is an orc found patrolling the streets of Orgrimmar.
Scout Boldbrew is a dwarf located at the Shimmer Ridge in Dun Morogh during the Blood in the Snow scenario. She was captured by the Frostmane.
Scout Forgefellow is a dwarf located at the Shimmer Ridge in Dun Morogh during the Blood in the Snow scenario. He was captured by the Frostmane.
Scout Stonebeard is a dwarf located at the Shimmer Ridge in Dun Morogh during the Blood in the Snow scenario. He was captured by the Frostmane.
Scout Ruk'Gan is an orc located at the Bones of Agurak and Agurak's Fall in Frostfire Ridge.
Scout-o-Meter Mk III is a mechanical dragon located at the Domination Point in the Krasarang Wilds.
Scout Rokla is an orc located at Horde Landing Site in Krasarang Wilds.
Scout Igor Corti is a human located on Turalyon's Might heading to Durotar in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Scott Trujillo is a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus.
Scout McKellis is a human located in Arom's Crossing in Drustvar.

Scorxia was a black dragon that assailed the Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores alongside her fellows in the Obsidian Brood. She appears to have been slain, and her horn fashioned into a warhorn by the Qalashi djaradin; specifically Boneshaper Jardak. Exadria asks adventurers to collect the horn alongside others.
Scout Yribria is a high elf general goods vendor located at Windrunner's Overlook in Crystalsong Forest.
Scoutmaster Hasark is an orc located north of the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands. Attacking him would make Shadow Clones appear.
Scribe Chi-Yuan is a human inscription trainer found in Andromath's Rise in Stormshield.

Scuttle Frostprow is a gnome mage located at the Scalawag Point in the contested territory of the Howling Fjord. She sends adventurers to kill the alpha lion seal, Big Roy, so she can use his blubber as a soap to clean the pirate ship docked at the point.
Scroot is an orc grunt found near the southwest gate of the Frostwall Garrison.
Sea Seer Crystal is a human located in Salt and Shanty in Boralus.
Sea Turtle Rider is a human located in the Battle on the High Seas.
Seamus Thundermaul is a Wildhammer dwarf and the father of Brannigan Thundermaul.
Seamus Goldenkicks is a dwarf mage found in Lion's Landing. He can also be seen in the Underhold maintaining the portal to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms during the Siege of Orgrimmar.

Seaghdh was a Wildhammer dwarf during the Second War. He was one of the Wildhammers who fell during the second raid on the orcs who were helped by the forest trolls. His death was reported to Kurdran by Beathan.
Seanus Copeland is a human ghost located on the steps just outside Glorious Goods at The Eventide in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.

Sean Wilkers is a human located at Eastwall Gate in Eastern Plaguelands. He accompanies the adventurer to Stratholme where he cleanses the defeated Sludge Belcher. The cleansed abomination is then used by the adventurer to clear out the Scourge at the Slaughter Square.
Second Mate Shandril was a human found on a small piece of land in Azshara watching over and waiting for the crew to escape the wreckage of the Horizon Scout.
Sebastian Bower is a human located at the Cantrips & Crows tavern in Underbelly. During the purge of Dalaran, he was cowering in fear.
Second Mate Florinius is a blood elf located aboard The Black Arrow in Darkshore during the Battle for Darkshore.
Seer Kaya is a tauren priest trainer on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
Seer Alsoomse is a tauren priest trainer located in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

Seer Galekk is an orc a member of the Earthen Ring found in Deepholm and then the Twilight Highlands. In Deepholm, he is found near the Twilight Overlook where he gives a quest, and is later found in the Temple of Earth where he is battling the invading Twilight Cultists. In the Twilight Highlands, he has been pulled into the Maw of Madness.

Seladan was a night elf who sought out Illidan Stormrage in Outland to fight the Burning Legion. His entire body was badly burned from the blows of an infernal. After undergoing the rites to become a demon hunter, he threw himself from the battlements of Karabor out of horror at what he had become.
Sedona Ironshot is a dwarf that would be part of the Legion Invasions.
Seething Chaos was an Azerite trait for Havoc demon hunters. It was removed from the database shortly after the Battle for Azeroth beta began.
Seer Skyhoof was a tauren priest held in a Quilboar Cage in Mulgore.
Seer Brighthorn is a tauren priest standing next to Malakai Cross in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.
Senator Barin Redstone is a dwarf located in the High Seat in the Great Forge in Ironforge. He's a member of the Senate of Ironforge.
Sempstress Ambershine is a blood elf tailoring trainer located at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods.
Sentinel Shaya is a night elf located just south of Dolanaar on Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Sentinel Keldara Sunblade was a night elf sentinel located at Haldarr Encampment in Azshara. When mind-controlled the satyrs didn't seem to attack her, why this was remains unknown. Since the Cataclysm, she is nowhere to be seen, particularly with the area seemingly strip-mined by the Bilgewater goblins.

Sen'zir Beastwalker is a Jungle Troll hunter from the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game. She once fought Onyxia Quotes from her and references to her can be found on the following cards: :Sen'zir reached back to her quiver and pulled out... nothing. She'd struck this beast with every arrow she had, and still it stood. - Growing Rage :"Let loose da animal within, bruddah!" - Bestial Rage

Selia Sunglow is a blood elf located at Dawnrise Expedition in Tanaris. She is a member of the archaeologists family Sunglow, like Aoren Sunglow and Lidia Sunglow, the latter being nearly identical to Selia.
Selyria Groenveld is a worgen agent of the Cenarion Circle seeking to cleanse the Plaguelands. She was one of the druids who re-cultivated Dalson's Farm.
Senara Swiftsilver is a blood elf vendor located at Bloodwatcher Point in the Badlands.
Sentry Mimao is a pandaren general goods vendor located at Huojin Landing on the Timeless Isle.
Selis is a human located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Sentinel Dawnshadow is a night elf located in Lunarfall in . She appears in the garrison's Town Hall when a level 3 Barracks is built.
Senior Peon II is an orc peon and assistant of the goblin Skaggit that appears in Frostwall during its development stages.
Sentinel Mysara is a night elf located at Twilight Grove in Duskwood. When Ariden killed Valorn and took off, Mysara and Daressa chased after him.
Sentinel Daressa is a night elf located at Twilight Grove in Duskwood. When Ariden killed Valorn and took off, Daressa and Mysara chased after him.
Selenis was an elf that was training to become a demon hunter. While he survived the first part of the ritual, he was driven mad, attacked his fellow trainees and died while fighting them.
Sense Death was a Fury warrior artifact trait. It was linked to the Bloodcraze (artifact trait) and Juggernaut (artifact trait) traits.
Sentry Captain Seldranath is a draenei hunter sentry captain of the Unseen Path located in Trueshot Lodge.
Selma Crump is a human located in Barrel & Crate in Boralus.
Sentinel's Perception is a row 7 hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Sentinel's Protection.
Sentinel's Perception is a row 7 hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Sentinel's Perception.
Selthera is a green dragon in a night elf visage found next to Kurazidaia in the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken
Selrian Stagroot is a night elf found in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream.
Seril Scourgebane is a human weaponsmith located in Everlook in Winterspring.

Sergeant was the warrior trainer of Durnholde Keep at the time of Thrall's imprisonment there. The real name of "Sergeant" is unknown, but he is described as "huge by human standards", easily over six feet tall. He had red hair, with a long beard, a barrel-chest and wore a black scarf and an earring in his left ear. A tough, seasoned fighter, he let his recruits know who was in charge, but also kept a sense of compassion for them.
Seriadne is a night elf stable master located in Dolanaar in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Sergeant De Vries is a human drink vendor and morale officer of the Stormwind Guard located at the Westbrook Garrison in Elwynn Forest. He can be found on the ground floor of the keep in a room to the left of the entrance.
Sergeant Maclear is a human located in Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.
Sergeant Bly is a human found in Zul'Farrak along with his party. Bly is and assists during the Pyramid battle, but becomes when questioned about the Divino-matic Rod.
Serpent's Swiftness is a hunter talent in the Beast Mastery talent tree. Players may assign up to 5 talent points in this talent.
Sergeant Kien was a blood elf who could be found in Hall of Legends in Orgrimmar.
Sergeant Malthus is a human located inside the Stockpile in Stranglethorn Vale.

Seraphina Bloodheart is a blood elf stable master located in front of the Inn of the Sun's Reach Harbor of the Isle of Quel'Danas. She spawns once players have retaken the Harbor. Her pet, is next to her.
Sergeant Dalton is a human located in Honor Hold in the Hellfire Peninsula. Sergeant Dalton later appears in Dalaran, where he directs Alliance warriors to Danath Trollbane at Krasus' Landing.
Sergeant Hammerhill is a dwarf located in Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.

Sergeant Morigan is a human found in the Caverns of Time instance, Culling of Stratholme. He has noticed a lot of unusual activity, mostly men in black robes, and questions citizens about them. One citizen in particular is Silvio Perelli. It's unknown what became of him.
Sergeant Daelian is a human located at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.
Sern Hallows is a human rogue trainer located at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
Sergeant Curtis is a rare human found in Tiragarde Keep in Durotar. He, along with the other Northwatch Expeditionary Force members, came in search of survivors there.

Sergeant Krolan is a dwarf located in the Alliance's Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. He is standing around a table with Corporal Nobsy and Commander Vines. He died during the assault of the Ironmarch and his body is still found at Nethergarde Keep. His shield was recovered.

Sergeant Verdone is a human found leading the Scarlet Guardians in the Huntsman's Cloister of the Scarlet Halls. They cannot be bypassed until Houndmaster Braun has been slain which triggers a group of dogs to swarm the guardsmen, clearing the way for the adventurers.

Sergeant Bonesnap is an orc sergeant located in Bonesnap's Camp in the territory of Grizzly Hills. He is in charge of the Horde's Conquest Hold assault on Silverbrook, and is considered one of Krenna's best sergeants. He is accompanied by a Conquest Hold Marauder guard, and is holding the Captured Trapper until her execution. He was supposed to be skinned by the Alliance adventurer as a test of mettle by the Silverbrook worgen. However, this gets interrupted by the Captured Trapper.
Sergeant Grud is an orc located at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh during Theramore's Fall.
Sergeant Brond is an orc located at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh during Theramore's Fall.
Serene Mists is a level 100 monk talent, added in Warlords of Draenor.

Sergeant Grimjaw is an orc who serves as the garrison quartermaster in Frostwall. He leads Frostwall's defense against enemy invasions and offers a number of items in exchange for Garrison Resources. His Alliance counterpart is Sergeant Crowler. Grimjaw was present at the Dranosh'ar Blockade during preparation for the Horde assault on the Broken Shore. He appeared to be in charge of the many followers there, watching them near their sparring ring.

Sergeant Schmidt is an officer in the Stormwind Army and Alliance military, who originally served in the Ashran campaign on alternate Draenor. There, Schmidt stood guard at the entrance to Stormshield Stronghold, the Alliance's primary base. Some time afterward, he was assigned to the Skyguard gunship, which notably took part in the battle for the Seething Shore and its :Azerite resources.

Seona Fireweaver is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, she appears in Stormwind Harbor at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.

Serka is an orc located in the Barracks of Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. Serka is one of several recruiting officers available to the hero. She offers the opportunity to replace racial garrison guards with the default Orgrimmar orcs. She is only available to players after constructing a level 3 Barracks.
Sergeant Gurmrok is an orc located at the Vol'jin's Pride in Talador. As a brown-skinned orc, it is unknown if he hails from the Frostwolf Orcs or another clan.
Sergeant Mollins is a human located at the Fort Wrynn in Talador.
Sergeant Vitasipe is a human located in Wrynn Artillery Tower at Fort Wrynn in Talador.
Sergeant Mor'grak is an orc located at the Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.

Sergeant Wilson is a human Battleground recruiter, and will appear if the queue for Ashran for the Horde is exceptionally high. He can put the Mercenary Contract buff upon the player, allowing them to fight alongside the Alliance. He wears an Orc Male Mask. He also appears in the Underbelly of Dalaran and the Mugambala arena in Zuldazar. He can also be found in the Enclave in Oribos. He also appears in Gladiator's Refuge in Valdrakken.
Sergeant Karzok was an orc located in Frostwall. He appeared when the barracks were build.

Serena Everwind was a night elf priestess who fought for the Kaldorei Resistance during the War of the Ancients. During one battle, she witnessed Dath'Remar Sunstrider wielding :Felo'melorn against the Burning Legion, and the description of the battle from her personal writings forms the second part of the story of the runeblade in the Archive of the Tirisgarde.
Serenity Now is a Holy priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Trust in the Light, Light of T'uure and Say Your Prayers (artifact trait) traits.

Sergeant Sally is a reckless gnomish police officer active in Gadgetzan in the Mean Streets of Gadgetzan expansion for Hearthstone. Described as a "loose cannon" that has given every guard captain she's served under bouts of severe chronic heartburn, Sally is a "knee-high bundle of righteous fury" that doesn't give a second thought to political woes. All that matters to her is justice and achieving results by any means necessary. Her reckless attitude has seen her plastered with commendations throughout her career, but also almost countless charges of misconduct. Sally is "clearly crazy" and will often throw herself into seemingly unwinnable situations, relishing any challenge that comes her

Sergeant Rantack was a soldier of Honor Hold who got killed by the Bleeding Hollow clan, his insignia now serving as a cursed talisman for them. He was a tough soldier and Corporal Ironridge's superior.
Sergeant Calvin is a human located at Brennadam Square in Stormsong Valley.
Sergeant Matthew Walker is a human located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Sergeant Davies is a human located at Old Drust Road north of Vigil Hill in Tiragarde Sound. She is seen speaking with a group of Fletcher's Hollow Refugees.
Serrated Glaive is a conduit for vengeance demon hunters. It drops from Tred'ova in the Mists of Tirna Scithe and The Nine in the Sanctum of Domination.
Sergeant Wayne is a human located in Talanji's Rebuke in Zuldazar.
Serene Dreams Spa Promoter is a dragon in high elf visage located in Valdrakken.
Setrastrasza is a red dragon who inhabits the Vermillion Redoubt.
Servando Lupo is a human located in Bradensbrook in Val'sharah.
Seth Spaulding is a human located in Ruff Waters in Boralus.
Setara Blazestrike is a dwarf located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
Sevis Brightflame is a blood elven demon hunter who was part of the Illidari forces that assaulted Mardum during the attack on the Black Temple.
Sha'leth is a night elf located in Suramar. She can be found on the Grand Promenade above the Aquarium of Wonders.

Shad Sharpwit is the leader of the Virtuous Blades. He has hidden parts of the band's treasures in Tiragarde Sound. Four Buried Treasure Chests can be found, when following the clues left behind in the following maps: *Singed Treasure Map‎‎ *Fading Treasure Map‎‎ *Soggy Treasure Map‎‎ *Yellowed Treasure Map‎‎

Shadow Lord Fel'dan is an orc found in Shadow Hold in Felwood. He uses his succubi to brainwash mortals into serving him or to lure them in so that he can sacrifice them to his demonic masters with whom he made pacts. He eventually became a fel orc, and was said to be "more demon than orc".
Shadow Affinity is a priest talent in the Shadow tree, available after spending 5 talent points in the tree. It reduces the threat generated by Shadow spells.

Shadow Hunter Denjai is a jungle troll shadow hunter of the Darkspear tribe that commands the Horde forces in Zangarmarsh from Zabra'jin. According to his soldiers, he can be a little intimidating at first, but once one gets used to him, he's not so bad, and has a temper. He sent Zurai and a small contingent of builders and warriors to establish Swamprat Post. As soon as the outpost was established, Denjai asked for a report. From Zabra'jin, he was dealing with the threats of the Ango'rosh ogres and the Daggerfen Lost Ones, asking Horde adventurers to thin their numbers and kill their leaders. He is also seen in Vol'mar Hold in Tanaan Jungle, where he serves as the quartermaster for Vol'jin'

Shadow Priest Anund was a dwarf priest who participated in the battle with the dread wyrm, Kaldrigos. He died due to standing in the dragon's arcane breath. Why he was standing in front of Kaldrigos is anyone's guess, but he made the rather poor decision of trying to heal himself through it with First Aid. Nevertheless, legend has it that Anund's final Shadow Word: Pain was key in helping Korl defeat the dread wyrm.
Shadow Hunter Ukambe is a jungle troll shadow hunter of the Darkspear tribe in Frostwall of Frostfire Ridge and later in Spires of Arak.
Shadow Hunter Kajassa is a jungle troll shadow hunter of the Darkspear tribe in Frostwall of Frostfire Ridge and later in Talador and .

Shadow Hunter Mutumba is a jungle troll shadow hunter of the Darkspear tribe located Vol'mar, the main Horde base in Tanaan Jungle. She appears in Nazmir. Mutumba is also present near Fort Daelin in Stormsong Valley during the Faction Assaults. She killed three Battalion Guards. She is present in Zanchul in Dazar'alor during Talanji's coronation.
Shadow Hulk is a dire pale orc located at the Lost Veil Anzu in Spires of Arak.
Shadow Hunter J'wan is a jungle troll shadow hunter located at in . Upon rescuing his spirit, he can sometimes visit Frostwall.
Shadow Hunter Maloa is a jungle troll shadow hunter located at in . Upon rescuing his spirit, he can sometimes visit Frostwall.

Shadow Hunter Spar'kuhl is a jungle troll shadow hunter located at the in . Upon rescuing his spirit, he can sometimes visit Frostwall. He was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade. Oddly enough, he is fully alive.
Shadowfiend is a priest talent. It is automatically learned for Discipline and Shadow priests. A pet action bar appears for the priest to command and control the Shadowfiend's spells.
Shadowmaster Aameen is a human located in Bizmo's Brawlpub in Deeprun Tram and in Brawl'gar Arena. He is the third encounter of rank 3.
Shadowmaster O'Flannerty is a dwarf located in Bizmo's Brawlpub in Deeprun Tram.

Shagara is an orc shaman and the leader of a unit of the Garad'kra. She honors the ideals that Thrall upheld during his time as warchief, even when her companions in the Garad'kra pursue their own goals over serving the greater good.
Shahme Grimsmoke is an orc located in Stonetusk Watch in Stormsong Valley.

Shalis Darkhunter is a night elf warden and the member of the Shadow Wardens, Watchers and The Wardens. Unlike other wardens, Shalis does not wield the traditional Umbra Crescent, wielding instead a two-bladed sword and, later, a bow.
Shaniri is a draenei hunter trainer located at Blood Watch in Bloodmyst Isle.

Shani Freezewind is a human mage captain of the Alliance, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Freezewind or another random Alliance Captain will spawn each time the Alliance reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.
Shane Webster is a human located at the Old Coast Path in Azsuna.

Sharak Tor is an orc warrior located in Skyhold, home of the Valarjar within the Halls of Valor. As a soldier of the Horde and member of the Kor'kron, he acts as a recruiting officer for Kor'kron shock troops at the behest of the Battlelord.
Shaohao's Lessons is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Veil of Pride.

Shargha was an orc chieftain residing in his stronghold in Kalimdor. He discussed the world's state of affairs with Boraga. Boraga saw Kalimdor as a land in ruins, while Shargha saw Kalimdor as a land of opportunities.

Sharpened Glaives is a Havoc demon hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Warglaives of Chaos, Balanced Blades (demon hunter artifact trait), Critical Chaos (artifact trait) and Feast on the Souls traits.
Sharpened Fang is a Survival hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Iron Talons and My Beloved Monster traits.

Shield Bash was a warrior skill in the Protection tree. It required a shield to be equipped and was capable of interrupting spellcasting. If a spell was interrupted, all spells in that school were locked for 6 seconds. Shield Bash also dazed the target. It was learned at level 12 for .
Shield Wall is a Protection warrior talent. When activated it reduces damage taken by 40% for 12 seconds. It has a 3 minute cooldown.
Shayis Steelfury is a an orc blacksmithing trainer located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
Shelby Stoneflint is a dwarf stable master located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Shelby was rescued by an adventurer during Legion Invasions of Dun Morogh.

Sheri Zipstitch is a human tailoring vendor found in Darkshire. She is in the large house just northeast of the town fountain, upstairs with Danielle Zipstitch. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Sheri was seen cowering in fear when the Veiled Hand controlled the town.
Shelgrayn is a night elf stable master located in Nijel's Point in Desolace.
Shen Kang Cheng is a level 75 human staff vendor located in the Militant Mystic, Eventide in Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, he was cowering in fear.

Sheldaris was a red-haired high elf ranger who served under Sylvanas Windrunner's command during the Third War. She was one of the three scouts sent to investigate the Scourge army, the other two being Kelmarin and Vor'athil. While Kelmarin returned to Sylvanas to inform her about the approaching army, she and Vor'athil had waited for Sylvanas to come with the bulk of the rangers. She was killed during the first struggle with the Scourge.
Shely Steelbowels is a human blacksmith found atop Deathbringer's Rise when the raid defeats Deathbringer Saurfang. He will repair the players gear and sell a small amount of items.
Shazdar is an orc cooking vendor found next to Marogg near Borstan's Firepit on the upper level of the Drag in Orgrimmar.
Shenara is an orc blacksmith vendor found at Hellscream's Watch in Ashenvale.
Shep Goldtend is a dwarf stable master located at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.

Shelly Hamby is a human Subtlety rogue who was one of the leading peasants at the Alliance champion's garrison. After the champion had returned from Embaari Village, another peasant reported that she and several of the other lumberjacks had gone missing. The champion's investigation led to finding that they and her husband had been captured and for the most part killed by the podlings of Gloomshade Grove. Shelly survived the ordeal and became a follower after her rescue. Her Horde counterpart is Mulverick. She can also be seen watching fights between garrison commanders in the Coliseum of Highmaul.
